defect: PostgREST serialises numeric(78,0) as a JSON number, so a 21-digit DreamDEX order id lost precision on the round trip and every derived reservation key was wrong.
blastRadius: 53 reservation rows keyed on a value that matched nothing in the contract
the lifecycle worker read those keys, so every releaseOrder answered NothingToRelease and it silently released nothing
the domain stayed pinned at its ceiling and all three agents were refused DOMAIN_RISK_EXCEEDED
notAffected: the contract, which never reads a projection
admission decisions, which are re-derived on chain at execution time
the intents and receipts projections, whose identity is intent_hash
fixes: indexer keeps the admitted pool/nonce/orderId in memory for the reconcile in the same transaction, so the values never make the round trip
every numeric(78,0) column is selected ::text by the API
projection writes are checked; an unchecked supabase-js upsert is a silent no-op, which is how a bad column name went unnoticed
lifecycle marks a reservation NEEDS_RECONCILIATION when the contract has no record under its key, instead of reporting success

verification.method: The contract emits its own orderKey in ReservationReleased. The TypeScript mirror was re-derived from the matching IntentAdmitted log and compared.

repair: Reservation rows deleted, cursor rewound, projections rebuilt from chain logs. Nothing was reconstructed by hand.
